cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref
binary=cli.build()
# ::/0 (hop 5) + 2001:db8::/48 (hop 9) + 2001:db8:1::/64 (hop 7) + fe80::/16 -> structural golden check
d = {}
def put(hi, lo, ln, hop):
    hi, lo = pyref.norm(hi, lo, ln)
    d[(hi, lo, ln)] = hop
    return ["put", "%016x%016x" % (hi, lo), ln, hop]
ops = [put(0,0,0,5),
       put(0x20010db8 << 32, 0, 48, 9),
       put((0x20010db8 << 32) | 0x0001, 0, 64, 7),
       put(0xfe80 << 48, 0, 16, 4),
       put((0x20010db8 << 32) | (0x11 << 16), 0, 80, 11)]
ops += [['save'], ['load_saved', 0]]
addrs = ['00000000000000000000000000000000', '20010db8000000010000000000000000',
         '20010db8001100000000000000000000', 'fe8000000000000000000000000000001',
         '20010db8001200000000000000000000']
ops += [['image_query', addrs], ['query', addrs]]
res = cli.results({'cases':[{'ops':ops}]}, binary)[0]
snap = res['snapshots'][0]
print('loads', res['loads'])
print('answers', res['answers'])
got = pyref.validate(snap)
print('validated prefixes', sorted([(hex(k[0]),hex(k[1]),k[2],v) for k,v in got.items()]))
# dump node structure summary
for (s,c,depth,origin,rhi,rlo,bmp) in pyref.LAST_NODES:
    w = int(snap['banks'][s][c//2],16); off = 128 if c%2 else 0
    t = pyref.field(w, off, 3)
    print('  stage %2d cell %3d origin %2d depth %3d type %d bmp %7s r %016x%016x' % (s,c,origin,depth,t,
          ('null' if bmp==4194303 else bmp), rhi, rlo))
PY
